refresh.trigger: A runtime module named in a locator changes, a provider is added to core/registry/capabilities.json, or a models.json retrieval slot is declared

rows.subject: Task class proposed by the model and validated against the workflow registry

locator.observed: proposedClass "feature"; validClasses lists the nine registry classes

rows.note: Validation of a proposed class is code (src/runtime/task-classifier.ts:441). The proposal itself is made by the model; no code derives a task class or an information need from the request text.

rows.subject: Information-need intents the router accepts

locator.observed: node bin/doflow.js route --intent find-symbol --check --json → exit 2, "Declared intents: locate-known-symbol, locate-concept, trace-dependency, estimate-blast-radius, inspect-history, verify-runtime-behavior, compress-command"

rows.note: Seven declared intents. A caller names the intent; the router does not classify free text.

rows.subject: BM25 search over the installed guidance tree

locator.observed: ranked results with path, score and snippet, for example references/EVIDENCE_LEDGER.md

rows.note: A standalone verb (src/runtime/knowledge/retrieval.ts:122 searchGuidance, bm25Rank :34). It is not a provider in core/registry/capabilities.json, so route cannot reach it, and it searches guidance only.

rows.subject: Semantic index ownership for semble.search

locator.ref: node bin/doflow.js retrieval-plan --action declare --task-id inv-probe --stage inventory --need locate-known-symbol,locate-concept --json
locator.observed: providers["semble.search"].state UNKNOWN: "no semantic index found at any location DoFlow knows to check; the provider owns its own layout"

rows.note: DoFlow routes to semble and graphify but does not build, locate or refresh their indexes; their freshness reads UNKNOWN (src/runtime/retrieval-plan.ts:189).

rows.subject: models.json retrieval slots (dense, rerank)

locator.observed: test/registry/models.test.js:31 asserts registry.retrievalSlots deepEqual []; git grep resolveRetrievalSlot finds its definition in src/runtime/model-router.ts, a comment at src/runtime/knowledge/retrieval.ts:8 and tests

rows.note: The slot mechanism is declared: src/registry/index.ts:85 reads models.slots and resolveRetrievalSlot returns {active:false} unless a slot is declared and enabled. The shipped core/registry/models.json has no slots key and no production caller of resolveRetrievalSlot exists, so no slot is bound to a provider and none has been invoked.

rows.subject: Declare the needs of a stage, then report each one

locator.ref: node bin/doflow.js retrieval-plan --action declare --task-id inv-probe --stage inventory --need locate-known-symbol,locate-concept --json, then --action report
locator.observed: needs[].result UNREACHED for both intents; providers native.rg NOT_APPLICABLE, semble.search UNKNOWN

rows.note: Declare and report work (src/runtime/retrieval-plan.ts:277 declarePlan, :370 reportPlan). The plan records what was declared and what was reached; it does not run retrieval.

rows.subject: fuseHybridResults: reciprocal-rank fusion of lexical and semantic results

locator.observed: git grep -n fuseHybridResults -- src test bench finds hybrid.ts:92,148, retrieval.ts:180,193 (a re-export) and two test files; no call from a verb or runtime path

rows.note: The function exists and is unit-tested. Nothing in src/ calls it outside the re-export, and handleRetrieveCommand ranks with bm25Rank only, so hybrid retrieval is not operational.

rows.subject: Evidence ledger records items and refuses retrieval scores

locator.observed: "'--relevance-score' is a retrieval score and this boundary records none (FR-007)"; the process exits 2

rows.note: Refusal on argv at src/cli/index.ts:335, on the option object at src/runtime/cli.ts:244 (assertNoScoreFields). Items are added at src/runtime/evidence-ledger.ts:128.

rows.subject: Evidence is linked to a declared need by provider or capability, not by the query
rows.note: evidenceIdsFor matches an item to a need when source.provider or source.capability equals the need's. Two queries to one provider are indistinguishable, so evidence is bound by provider, not to the query or attempt that produced it.

rows.subject: context-pack verb compiles evidence and claims with item-count caps only

locator.observed: node bin/doflow.js context-pack --task-id inv-probe --json → budgetEnforcement.limits {maxFiles 15, maxClaims 20, maxEvidenceItems 25, maxResearchRequests 20}; "empty": true; exit 1

rows.note: The verb calls compileContextPack with no byte or token budget. It takes no capacity input and does not read the harness context window.

rows.subject: compileBoundedContextPack: byte budget per task class

locator.observed: TASK_CLASS_BUDGETS at src/runtime/context-pack.ts:14 (feature 225000 down to trivial-edit 30000 bytes); the only callers are test/runtime/context-pack-budget.test.js

rows.note: Declared and tested, but no verb calls it (its alias compileBoundedPayload, src/runtime/context-pack.ts:427, has no caller at all), so the budgets are not applied to a delivered context pack.

rows.subject: verify compiles a verification contract and reports against it

locator.ref: node bin/doflow.js verify --task-id inv-probe --json (run in an empty git repository)
locator.observed: status INCONCLUSIVE, reason "No tier produced a result; nothing was verified"; tier parse UNRESOLVED, no project manifest found

rows.note: The engine runs (src/runtime/verification/engine.ts:1263 handleVerifyCommand). In a project with no manifest it reports INCONCLUSIVE rather than passing.

rows.subject: readiness evaluates the task-class contract against recorded evidence

locator.observed: state NEEDS_EVIDENCE; "Task requires 3 additional evidence item(s) before implementation."

rows.note: src/runtime/cli.ts:92 handleReadinessCommand. It counts evidence kinds named in the template; it does not measure retrieval quality.

rows.subject: Retrieval quality measurement (recall, MRR) over any provider

locator.observed: bench/advice bench/baseline bench/do-brainstorm … bench/do bench/native; there is no bench/retrieval

rows.note: No benchmark at this commit measures what a retrieval provider returns against a labelled answer. Feature 074 adds it.

gateSentence: Registry slots alone do not establish operational hybrid support.
